Fixed three real, pre-existing bugs that had kept every CI run red since P0: numpy==2.5.3 has no Python 3.11 wheel (repinned 2.4.6), extract_metrics crashed on an outline-less system font on ubuntu-latest, and a CLI test asserted against Rich-wrapped --help text that splits mid-flag on CI terminal widths.

web/ frontend scaffold (Vite+TS+pdf.js) plus UI-01 (page canvas + thumbnail rail) and UI-06 (password prompt), with real Playwright end-to-end evidence and CI wiring. Four real bugs found and fixed: missing CORS policy, a pdfjs-dist CVE avoided plus the getOrInsertComputed browser-compat gap it exposed, a real button/keyboard listener race in viewer.ts, and a password-retry message logic bug.

PageSpansOp/PreviewTextOp/ReplaceSpanTextOp backend, then UI-02 click-to-edit overlay and UI-03 inspector panel frontend, with 9 new Playwright tests (20 total in tests/web/). Caught a design gap before shipping (ReplaceTextOp would edit every occurrence of matched text, not just the clicked span) and two real bugs via automated browser testing: an inspector layout bug (text set inside a prepended icon element instead of a sibling text node) and a genuine JS reentrancy bug (contentEditable=false synchronously firing blur, re-entering cancelEdit before the outer call finished).
